title: But ours is the omphalos.
html_source: Greek for “navel”, meaning that the tower is source of all others. The tower at Sandycove was the first in Ireland to be constructed, to protect from approaches to Dublin by military invaders. It is the centre of Buck’s and Stephen’s life but it is culturally British.
